why_ai: Adversarial testing by exceptional experts, with firm accountability for what the report claims.
why_clarity: Findings are concrete, but coverage is unstated and remediation never returns.
why_digital: Attack digital estates remotely and deliver a digital report.

why_ai: Known weakness classes are already automated; only business logic flaws need human testers.
why_clarity: Vulnerability classes are well catalogued and findings are reproducible.
why_digital: Code and running applications tested remotely on screen.

why_ai: Insurers and clients need a firm to stand behind what a clean result means.
why_clarity: Whether a clean report reflects real security is learned only after a breach.
why_digital: Assurance statements produced from digital engagement evidence.

why_ai: Framework-scoped tests need a credible signatory, but automated platforms produce the artefact.
why_clarity: Scope is defined by the framework and the auditor accepts or rejects the report.
why_digital: Scans and validation run remotely, delivered as a dated report.

why_ai: Coverage is computed from the tester's own recorded traffic.
why_clarity: Reached versus unreached surface is measurable the day testing ends.
why_digital: Traffic logs instrumented and summarised in software.

why_ai: Attack surface discovery and day estimates are derivable by automated reconnaissance.
why_clarity: Estimates are checked against actual estate size during the engagement.
why_digital: Asset discovery and quoting done remotely on screen.

why_ai: Simulating a capable adversary against one organisation is novel, adversarial judgment.
why_clarity: Each exercise is bespoke and its representativeness cannot be checked.
why_digital: Mostly remote intrusion, with some physical and social engineering.

why_ai: Finding-to-fix linkage automates, though the follow-up client relationship does not.
why_clarity: A retest shows objectively whether a fix closed the weakness.
why_digital: Retests and ticket linkage run remotely.

why_ai: Writing up known findings in client templates is mechanical assembly LLMs do.
why_clarity: Same finding descriptions recur hundreds of times in fixed formats.
why_digital: Structured findings turned into documents on screen.

why_ai: Prioritising findings by internal architecture and persuading other teams needs insider judgment.
why_clarity: True severity in context is debated and outcomes rarely confirm the ranking.
why_digital: Reports and tickets handled entirely on screen.

why_ai: Skilled hands-on testing resists automation even as the reporting burden is removed.
why_clarity: Testing method varies by tester and engagement while write-ups are templated.
why_digital: Remote testing and reporting on screen.
